open_questions.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?

risks.description: Potential loss of functionality during code translation.
risks.mitigation: Thorough testing and validation of Go implementation.
Conduct security audits and implement best practices.

out_of_scope: Development of new features not present in the Kotlin codebase.
Changes to existing data contracts without explicit approval.

relationships: LegacyInput contract must map deterministically to ModernizedOutput contract

standards_guidance.name: Android Architecture: MVVM + Unidirectional State Flow
engineering_actions: Keep UI state in a ViewModel exposed as StateFlow or Compose State.
Treat ViewModel as the single source of truth for screen-level state.
Emit one-shot side effects via a Channel / SharedFlow, not LiveData.

standards_guidance.name: Jetpack Compose-First UI
engineering_actions: New screens must be Composable functions; legacy XML layouts are interop bridges only.
Preview every screen with `@Preview` variants for light / dark / RTL.
Use Material 3 components unless an explicit design-system override exists.

standards_guidance.name: Offline-First Data Policy
engineering_actions: Reads must resolve from local cache first; network refresh is async.
Mutations enqueue to WorkManager or an equivalent persistent queue.
Conflict resolution is explicit (last-writer-wins or merge), never silent.

standards_guidance.name: Mobile Security Baseline
engineering_actions: Secrets at rest go through Android Keystore, never SharedPreferences.
Network calls to private APIs must use certificate pinning.
Release builds must enable R8 / ProGuard with keep rules for reflection points.

non_negotiables: All user-visible strings must be in string resources for localization.
No network calls on the main thread — use coroutines with Dispatchers.IO.
Every screen has at least one Compose preview and one instrumented test.
Release builds must pass lint with `-Werror` for critical severity rules.

must.title: Security Compliance
must.description: Ensure the Go implementation adheres to security standards.
must.metric: Pass all security audits with no critical findings.
acceptance_criteria: Security audits show no critical vulnerabilities.
All data at rest is encrypted using approved methods.
Network communications are secured with TLS.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: The system should maintain high availability and reliability.
acceptance_criteria: Failover mechanisms are tested and verified.
No critical outages during testing phase.

should.title: Performance Optimization
should.description: The Go implementation must meet or exceed the performance of the Kotlin version.
should.metric: Response time under 200ms for all critical operations.
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests indicate response times under 200ms.
Load tests show stable performance under expected user load.
No performance degradation observed in comparison to Kotlin.

should.title: Scalability
should.description: The Go implementation should support increased user load without degradation.
should.metric: Support for 10,000 concurrent users without performance loss.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests confirm support for 10,000 concurrent users.
Resource usage remains within acceptable limits under load.
No bottlenecks identified during scalability testing.

should.title: Usability
should.description: The Go implementation should maintain or improve user experience.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 4.5 out of 5.
acceptance_criteria: User testing results in a satisfaction score of 4.5 or higher.
Feedback indicates no usability regression from Kotlin.
All UI components are intuitive and responsive.
